* The Cortana Chronicles: Jen Taylor, the voice of Cortana, takes us on a tour of the worldwide Halo fan community, where she meets Halo fanatics from near and far, obscure and famous alike.
* All-new, exclusive Machinima episodes from Red vs Blue and This Spartan Life, as well as a novel "mockumentary" voiced by Sgt. Johnson himself, David Scully.

469943.overview: Experience intense speed and intuitive control with Halfbrick Rocket Racing! Use the two triggers to fire up rockets on either side of your craft, and simply alternate power to drift, slide and grind your way around over 40 tracks! With four-player racing and global leaderboards, Halfbrick Rocket Racing is packed with action.

469944.overview: Get five happyfaces in a row to clear them from the board and score points.

469945.overview: A true puzzle game without an action element. "Features" A mysterious virtual world where you can stand on any box or ball surface. Beautiful graphics with balls that reflect, refract and concentrate light amid colorful boxes. An entirely new experience! Thinking three-dimensionally makes this a simple but profound game.

469946.overview: Can you survive a supernatural adventure to claim your inheritance before All Hallow's Eve?

469948.overview:
The goal is hack the system, changing numbers positions and doing triple! Decrease the target number before timer fall to zero.

Let's see how far you can go!

469949.overview: Blast Off is an interstellar arcade game featuring gravity fields, lost astronauts and bizarre planetary systems. Use your rocket ship to rescue astronauts and carry them through the warpgate to safety. But be careful! The ever-present force of gravity can help you on your journey, but can also bring you crashing down.Each planet and celestial body within a level has a gravity effect which must be accounted for. This gravity must be used to the player’s advantage in combination with rocket boost power and directional control. Various hazards must be avoided, and if the ship crashes into an object the mission fails.- 45 missions across four difficulty settings.- Planets and Asteroids will have gravity and attract the ship, allowing players to float around the level.- Black Holes will attract the ship with even more ferocity.- White Holes have a reverse gravity field, pushing the ship away.- Mission success is ranked on several factors: remaining fuel, remaining air, astronauts collected.- Awarded Silver, Gold or Brick medals based on final mission outcome.Good luck and Blast Off!

469950.overview:
The sequel to the critically acclaimed Halloween Scream.

It is two years since you became a vampire. A new lead beckons... can you succeed against all odds and lift the family curse?

469951.overview: Frighten your friends and terrify your enemies with these creepy 5.1 halloween-themed soundscapes. Spooooooky!

469952.overview: Stop Lord Double Hockey Sticks in his attack on the United States! Stick Figures are revolting due to their comrades being killed in the game know as 'Hangman'. You must stop the Stick Figure Armies while acquiring top secret vehicle upgrades along the way. Vehicle modes include Tank, Helicopter, Hovercraft, and Submarine.

469953.overview:
In this game, you can make the world with “what could not be a part of the world” by transforming it.

Let's make your own world.

469954.overview: Classic family entertainment in a western setting. Guess the correct letters of the hidden word(s) before your character is hung.

469955.overview: Malcolm is tired of all the other kids in the neighborhood stealing his candy each Halloween. This year he is ready to take back what is rightfully his!

469956.overview: One of the most popular games of all time, now for your Xbox 360! Includes 30 word categories, 3 difficulty levels, high scores and many backgrounds to customize the game.

469958.overview: Oddly colorful, yet weirdly fun. Come take a dive into trip nation. Happy Pong will deliver your daily dose of abnormal in the convenience of a video game. This visual buffet offers a wide array of animated sensory experiences for you to choose from. Whatever happens, you are in for one wild ride.

469959.overview: Race to collect crystals while dodging the Echoes shadowing your footsteps in this innovative, seat-of-your-pants arcade game. Try the blend of action and strategy in Arcade Mode, the tense maneuvering of Clockwork Mode, the frenetic pace of Survival Mode or challenge a friend to an intense Duel Match. With dozens of surreal levels across seven unique gameplay modes, there's plenty for everyone.

469962.overview: You wake up one day to hear a stranger laughing at you, claiming that his reactor tank is bigger than yours. This cannot be happening! Choose your gladiator and prove your superiority in this hardcore, nonstop straight-in-your-face fast-paced 3D multiplayer action trip! Hard2Morrow comes with never-seen-on-indie cutting-edge graphics and an awesome metal driven soundtrack.

469974.overview: Shoot the killer before time runs out.

469975.overview:
Hartacon Tactics is a turn-based tactical RPG, featuring highly deterministic mechanics, beautiful hand-painted 2D art and deep gameplay.

Hire characters of unique classes, and wisely use their strengths, skills and weapons to defeat tough enemies as you travel through the continent of Kaus.

469976.overview: In Head-Banger, an avatar stands on the stage and bangs his head to one of four songs. Regarding gameplay, this is a standard rhythm game: on the top of the screen, there are four lines corresponding to the four buttons of the Xbox 360 gamepad (alternatively the Guitar Hero controller is also supported). Button icons come in from the right of the screen and when they reach a certain point, the player needs to press the button. A correct press rewards points (consecutive ones combo points) and a missed one retracts from the health bar. The game is over when the song is finished or health runs out.

469977.overview: A terrorist organization is loose in your city. They are masters of disguise and can expertly hide in a crowd. You are the best sniper we've got. It's your job to take them out!

469978.overview: Soldier, you're the only thing standing between these people and a nuclear bomb. If you don't contain this outbreak, well have no choice but to destroy the city. Shoot these zombies in the head!

469981.overview: Only the best will achieve the rank of HEADSMAN!

469982.overview:
In a world where love is taken for granted, one Cupid has had enough!

Play as the Anti-Cupid, using your abilities and special powers to crush budding romances, fighting the special forces of the Cupid agenda and generally ruin the day of anyone else in your path.

469983.overview:
The Hearts of Men: Throne of Deceit is an action game with similarities to the Gauntlet series. The motivations of the four heroes (warlock, viking, elf and warrior) are different, e.g. the viking seeks revenge for his murdered family, but the result is the same: visiting a dungeon and killing everything inside. The story is told with comic pages.

The most obvious change to the Gauntlet formula are the controls: when playing with a gamepad, it uses the twin-stick shooter style (movement and aim direction are controlled separately). The player moves through the maze-like dungeon, kills numerous enemies (most spawn from monster generators which should be destroyed to stop reinforcements) and searches for keys to open up the doors to the next section. Each enemy hits removes some of health bar and eventually leads to death. The player character then respawns at the location of death and loses a live; running out of them means the game is over. Of course there are some things which help to avoid this fate: the player can instantly warp a short distance (costs mana) and collect hearts (from fallen enemies) and meat to restore health. Between levels, collected coins are used to upgrade weapons and other abilities.

Each level ends with a boss fight and some sections use automatic scrolling. This means the player needs to constantly move forward and should avoid turns which lead to dead ends (and therefore instant death). While the campaign is designed for local co-op with up to four participants, it is also possible to play alone. Additionally there is an arcade mode available in which player(s) battle an endless horde of enemies. Here weapon upgrades have to collected from killed enemies. Online multiplayer is restricted to competitive modes like deathmatch.

469985.overview:
Hardboiled Pinball is the first game of the Stryde Games pinball series, which aims to provide an old-school fast scrolling 2D pinball experience.

Sharpen your reflexes to conquer the silver ball and score the jackpot in this crime noir themed table.

469986.overview:
Harmonium is a tone matrix game with a twist! Whether you're scribbling, drawing, or composing, the pentatonic design means it always sounds good! And what's the twist, you ask? Well, at any time you can turn on the "Life Mode" and let the music write itself!

Sit back and watch Harmonium apply John Conway's game of life to write generation after generation of autonomous music!

469987.overview:
Harvester is a game for the season. Race to harvest the most wheat before winter sets in.

Good luck.

469988.overview:
Heart and Mind are travelling across Poland in order to see the Championship. Help them to hit the ball into the goal. The fewer movements you make, the more points you get for each goal.

Collect bonuses in order to get additional points. You have to carry out additional tasks at 4 special levels.

469989.overview: Are you the Ultimate HaXor or just a LooZ3r? Outwit and out-maneuver your opponents to claim LEDs and become the top HaXor. Up to 4 people can play. Play against easy, hard, medium and expert AI. See how long you can survive...

469993.overview: Heavy Payload is an aerial shoot 'em up set over the European Theater of World War II. The player must use machine guns to defend their bomber from enemy planes en route to the mission target. The game has two distinct modes: Arcade (classic game play) and Advanced (a new twist to the original game). Each mode has 9 missions with 4 levels of difficulty.

469994.overview: Heavy Payload 2 is an aerial shoot 'em up set over the European Theater of World War II. The game has two modes (Arcade and Advanced) with 18 missions and 4 difficulty settings. Heavy Payload 2 has more enemies, faster machine guns, carpet bombing, a new map and other audio/visual enhancements.

469996.overview: Heavy Recoil: Convoy Chaser is a 2D side-scrolling platform run-and-gun game. The player can control one from three characters: Matti, Max or Annika (Annika is not in the OUYA version). They have different statistics for speed, energy and firepower. The character must go right, shoot enemies, jump on platforms, release captives, destroy barrels and collect bonuses such as secondary weapons like grenades or a laser beam that targets the entire field. The mechanics are similar to Contra, but the character can only shoot straight ahead. Up to three hidden stars can be collected per level. There is no continue option, so if all lives are lost the game is over.

469997.overview: In The Heckler, the player visits the show of a performance artist who reads poetry. By pressing a button makes an interjection and the player's point score rises. However, with each interjection the performer's annoyance bar rises. It decreases over time and if it rises above a certain level, he leaves the stage and the game is over.

469998.overview: You and your loyal servant wander the world seeking out the only thing all wizards truly love: gold. Use your spells, wits and helpful local peasants to get the gold before the village or your tower is burned, flooded, buried, eaten by zombies or in some other way horribly destroyed. The game includes over twenty puzzling levels.

470001.overview: Fly your helicopter through a dangerous cavern. And yes there is an end to the cave...you probably just aren't good enough to get there. Game play couldn't be simpler just press a to fly and let go to drop. Enjoy. Programming and art by Jordan Hample.

470017.overview: A girl alone in a haunted house ... will you be able to make her survive unharmed? Francesca Mamo, the same actress of "Bloody Death" lend her interpretation into the last nightmare from Brave men games.

470018.overview: Gather your friends and family for an exciting 4-player adventure! Gather armies of bugs to build the largest hoard, then convert them into 3 different attack bugs to be the last bug standing! With 7 levels, 4 difficulty levels, English and Spanish languages, and great artificial intelligence, prepare yourself for hours of competitive game play!

470019.overview:
Guitar Hero 5 has been cancelled and Rock Band has stopped DLC. Heroes of Rock gives gamers a chance to rock out again but in a whole new way - through an action game.

Heroes of Rock is a side scrolling action game designed for the guitar peripheral and injected with Heavy Metal influence. Experience original heavy metal music composed by Leeland Campana and take on the satanic music industry.

470020.overview:
Band with a group of friends to defeat the evil sorcerer who has converted you into small insects.

Face spiderwolves, mothamancers, and giant snails in your conquest to regain your human selves.

470021.overview: Battle through 12 levels of increasing difficulty to face the Hive's Queen in the final conflict in this addictive 2D Space Shooter.

470022.overview:
A war has broken out, deep underground, a Holy War...between Moles!

Battle as 1 of 5 fanatical moles, tunnel your way to victory through 24 hazard filled levels. A fight for up to 4 players, friends or CPU.

Use Power-Ups, win Awards and destroy your enemies in an effort to be the last mole standing.

470023.overview: The goal is to cross the road without being killed; hence this game is based on real life.

470025.overview: Legend says that Hellhounds guard the entrances to the underworld. And once you trespass their domains, there is no escape...

470026.overview: Helico Hero lets you fly four different helicopters in three different areas with multiple missions.

470027.overview: Hit a Home Run with your Avatar! Features: Addicting Gameplay, Global High Scores, Large Avatar Crowds, and much more! Smash targets and send the ball deep on your way to the top of the Global Highscore List! Home Run Challenge is for gamers of all ages and skill levels.

470029.overview: Play chess as you've never played it before! With six sides to each tile, more pieces and larger boards of up to 91 tiles, the game is more complex than a square, 64 piece board. Play against your friends on the same XBox with one or two controllers, or play against three different AI difficulties. Three different versions of board and gameplay available!

470030.overview: Hockey Fights is, as the title might suggest, a recreation of the most exciting part of a hockey match: the fights! Choosing from one of eight teams, the player must beat the snot out of the opposing player in best-of-three bouts. The player can punch or block both high and low; punching will reduce the player's energy, resulting in less damage, but energy can be recharged by blocking attacks. If three punches in succession connect, a "Jersey" attack will be launched where one player pulls the other's jersey over his face and punches him mercilessly, while the other player must mash buttons to break free. The player earns "Victory Points" for winning fights, which can be spent on ability upgrades for the various teams.

470031.overview: Be thankful for what you have.

470032.overview: The 'World Wide Interweb' has invaded the sport of boxing! Take on internet celebrity look-alikes in the quest to become the greatest meme slayer of all time.

470033.overview:
Experience fast paced hockey action with your friends at home, in an online match or by playing single player against the computer. You can create your own hockey team and battle for the win in local matches or online matches.

Be prepared for hockey action!

470034.overview:
In Hexothermic, atoms are aligned on a hexagonal grid. The player can select each desired atom and add electrons to it. If an atom has enough electrons, it explodes and hurls electrons into all six directions. The electron counter of each hit atom rises by one and may directly explode when its condition was right. Of course chain reactions reward bonus points for the high-score list. How many more electrons the atom needs is indicated by its color.

The player has only a limited amount of electrons available, but they can be earned back by creating chain reactions. The four playing modes are marathon (the game keeps going until all electrons are used), timed (similar as marathon but with an additional time limit), survival (the player has 99 electrons and can't earn any back) and puzzle (pre-determined situations which have to be solved with the provided electrons).

470035.overview: Get in the Holiday Spirit with some Holiday-themed trivia! Play as your Avatar with up to 3 other friends or family members and enjoy hundreds of Holiday-related questions while listening to wonderful Holiday music! Fun for all ages!

470036.overview: Can you steer the little rocket to its little target? Hello Rocket features hours of gameplay, hilarious physics-based demolition and lots of replay value. Complete with 72 levels of toppling towers, exploding bombs, rolling orbs and cute little bad guys that you bump into and knock over. Best. Game. Ever.

470037.overview: An evil dude has unleashed the Zombie Bunnies and now you, HomeSlice, have to send them packing. Slice and Shoot the Zombie Bunnies with high scores, unique game look, and play style.

470038.overview: Travel around galaxies by changing gravities to change your orbit. Avoid asteroids, black holes and more as you guide spaceships to their stations.

470039.overview:
Heroes of Hat is a multiplayer 3D puzzle platformer where you use the power of hats to traverse levels, solve puzzles, and fight enemy forces.

You'll have to tie all of your hat abilities together to make it through levels and conquer what lies at the end.

470040.overview: Take control of your Avatar and gamble your way to glory in the infamous Zombie Monkey Arena! Fight for your honor against hordes of Zombie Monkeys by smashing them to bananas.

470041.overview:
Hexement is a falling block puzzle puzzle viewed from a slightly angled top-down perspective. Players rotate and position descending blocks made of connected hexagons, each representing one of three elemental types: land, water, or fire. The interaction between the falling block and the tile it lands on determines the outcome - hexagons may stack or transform. For example, placing water on water adds another layer, while dropping fire on water removes one.

Strategic placement is essential, as terrain evolves dynamically. Volcanos form when fire is placed on fire or when neighboring tiles differ in height by more than four layers. These volcanos erupt after a fixed interval, introducing hazards that can destabilize the field. However, players can prevent eruptions by dropping water directly onto volcanos, which removes them. If no volcanos are present when an eruption is due, one is randomly created on the highest tile layer.

The game ends if water spills over the edge - triggered by placing water tiles on boundary hexagons - or if the field tilts due to uneven tile distribution. The objective is to survive as long as possible while accumulating points through block

470042.overview:
What's in Santa's sack? It's a Holiday Bonus that the whole family will love. Chill out with this cool winter-themed puzzle game from Grey Alien Games - it's slicker than Santa on an icy roof!

Line up the dancing seasonal shapes against stunning snowscape backgrounds with an epic music score and work your way up the decorated tree. You can gather winter scenes in your gallery and even display them on your desktop. Make the right moves and your power gauge will build a bigger, brighter bonus blowout!

This one's gonna snowball...so don't miss the festive fun!

Features:

- Family holiday fun
- Smooth addictive match-3 gameplay
- Beautiful winter backgrounds
- Gallery of unlockable pictures
- Crazy bonus items including Santa's sack!
- 55 unique levels
- Enchanting winter music
- Universal Binary for Macs

470043.overview: Simple but addictive 2D tennis game for 2 players. Easy to control but hard to master, find a worthy rival and you will suffer the "just one more match" syndrome. And remember to take advantage of the advanced physics and the game events.

470044.overview:
Guide Herbert in his skyship past squorbs dropped on the Rainbow Planet.

How long can you last?

470045.overview: Herman is a unique action scroller with 25 long levels, 5 difficulty levels and hours of gameplay. Herman is in the midst of a midlife crisis, and you must help him escape from work. The game has a brilliant story (told in over 200 beautiful backgrounds), 15 professional music tracks, many different enemies and a nice mix of upgrades, including Herman's lucky fedora! VERY challenging and fun.

470047.overview: Play with up to 4 people in order to fend off the zombie horde. Gain exp to learn new techniques. Can you survive?

470048.overview:
The ultimate alien shooting game is at hand mixing arcade classic into the modern world.

Fight your way through an infinite number of levels to rack up the points. Choose to play in one of several graphics packs including new style and Retro classics, or switch in real time between them during play.

470049.overview:
Angels want control of all Heaven, Hell and everything in between. Devils want the same thing. How to settle this? Battle with weapons? Been there, done that, got the T-shirt. Then somebody had an idea: DODGEBALL!

Hieronymus Bash is a dodgeball game between angels and devils. Two players can play on the same team or on opposing teams. Up to four players can play. The game, somewhat, plays like dodgeball. The ball is thrown at an opposing player. If the player is hit, they are out. If they catch the ball, the other player is out and an outed player can return. Last team standing, wins. The game is not on a flat playing field but there are, instead, platforms above and below.

470053.overview: With Cute or Trash Mode, Hop and Pop is "Some fun for smart people". Single, 2 player or Battle. Jump around, make color combinations and use more than 20 Powers to win. The more balloons you pop, the more points you get, but the faster it goes. Other Features : 20+ Awards to unlock, shout messages, 4 custom musics style, High-Scores, Quest or Battle mode

470057.overview:
Hop til you drop in this new multiplayer adventure. Collect the coins and avoid the dangerous obstacles.

Challenge up to three of your friends! The more you play the more Hoppers you unlock!

470066.overview: Jump in the cockpit of one of the year's most powerful and addicting Indie Games to hit the Marketplace. Featuring a full blown voice acting team, detailed graphics and intense gameplay, Honor In Vengeance will leave you speechless as you fly above Earth as Martian rebel pilot Juno Lucas, fighting for Mars' independence from Earth's abusive grip on the Martian colony.

470073.overview: Engaging real-time strategy and puzzle gameplay are combined in this slick and action-packed game. You are in charge of a tropical archipelago and must make careful use of each island's geography to outwit enemy pirates. Complete the game as a Cabin Boy or test your mettle as a Pirate King; unique puzzle island maps and features will push your skills as far as you care to take them!

470074.overview: Platformer meets vertical shoot-em-up in this retro genre mashup! Fight off alien hordes who are out to protect the valuable space gems you are rightfully trying to steal! 7 Levels of action plus challenging accomplishments to shoot for!

470080.overview: Hot Potato HD a high tech take on the popular childrens game Hot Potato! Pass the potato (in the form of the Xbox Controller) back and forth while the music plays. But be careful! If you're holding it when the music stops, Hot Potato! It's fun for the whole family.

470082.overview:
Campaign led, strategy game with city and army management. Defend the Kingdom from the Hordes of Evil Undead!

Quickbattle mode supports up to 4 local players with 5 different maps designed specifically for quickbattle mode.

Develop your cities and build bigger armies!

Complex AI, multiple map types, full on battle, defend the convoy, special missions.

470084.overview:
Tensions are at a high, weapons are at a ready.... and the only thing missing is a spark to set it all off.

Jump in the cockpit of Leo Lucas' starfighter, and lead the way for the Martian people as the Earth-Mars conflict reaches a climatic turn in the second installment of the Honor in Vengeance series.

470087.overview: You are one of the last of your kind. The endangered Horned Lizard, sometimes known as the Horned Toad. You are trying to survive by eating ants, but must defend yourself by the only ways you know how. Squirting blood at your enemies and running away. Play this fast paced twin stick top down shooter today.

470098.overview: Let's play a little game. Open 2 doors each turn. If both doors contain tenants, you save both tenants. If one door is a killer and one door is a tenant, you lose the tenant. Save 10 tenants to win each level. Be careful! The killers will move after every turn!

470099.overview:
The Houchi Play is a 2D title based on the popular real-life children's game Statues. The aim of the game is to get the character Taro Heibon close to cosplay girls without having the girls notice him. The player has to wait until the girl faces away and then quickly alternate between pressing the two trigger buttons quickly to move towards her. As soon as she faces Taro again, all movement must stop. On the way, he will pass some alcoholic beverages which are drunk by solving a quicktime event. Doing this fast and successful, improves Taro's movement speed. After all stages are passed, the girls can be viewed in a gallery.

During the standard challenge mode, Taro gains experience points based on the difficulty of the level. Reaching a level up improves his cuteness (more time before the girl turns around), quickness (maximal movement speed), stamina (how fast the momentum decreases) and drinking (difficulty of the quicktime events). Some girls have special behaviour traits, e.g. they sometimes close their eyes or do not announce when they turn back towards Taro. In free play, the player can choose unlocked girls and costumes freely.

470100.overview: House of Cockroach is 3D shooting game. Simply enter the house with full of cockroaches and there will be various rooms with 14 missions to completed. Using 3 different weapons (reflect gun, machine gun and bomb) to win against cockroaches.Build a highest score or challenge your friends and beat their score.

470101.overview: House of Spice is 3D arcade shooting game. Shooting monsters with spice gun at 4 different fresh locations. Beware of monsters shooting you back since it decreases life point. Collect Old Spice to increase life point.

470102.overview: Improve your reaction time with this addictive game!

470103.overview:
Are you ready to play the wildest, sexiest, scariest game ever made? No? Well good, then how about HOUSE OF 1000 DEMONS!?

Stumble through a house haunted with terrible demons from a dimension far more annoying then our own.

Are you a bad enough dude to save your house? Probably not.

470104.overview:
How to Get a Girlfriend consists of a series of questions aimed at measuring the user's knowledge about how to succeed with girls. For each question, there are four possible answers; only one is correct. Each answer is followed by a comment, that sets out why the right answer is so, and, for some questions, explains why the other ones are wrong.

A question, for instance, says: «A girl you like comes up to you and says she isn't interested in being with you. What do you do?». And available answers are:

Ask her why she thinks that and try to convince her otherwise.
Splash her with your drink.
Cut your losses and move on.
Act sad and start crying to make her pity you.
Questions finished, the game invites to restart or «go out and try your new moves!».

470105.overview: Hoyle Texas Hold 'em delivers the very best of Hold 'em style poker for the Xbox 360. Choose to play with up to 9 friends or against any combination of AI and Live players. Customize your game type by choosing limit, no limit, spread limit and table limit style games. Full support of Microsoft's Avatars let's you bring your own style to the game.

470106.overview: Defend your alien home world against 10 incoming waves of heavily armed human invaders.

470107.overview:
You've been abducted by aliens who are conducting tests on you to determine whether or not they should invade Earth.

Can you perform well enough to frighten them into changing their plans? Or do they have something else in mind?

470108.overview: Guide the snake around the board eating food. Just to spice things up a little, different foods have different effects on your snake.

470109.overview: Take the role of a dangerously powerful hypnotist in this dark story-driven experience. Use your abilities to cut a bloody swath through the city by ripping the intentions from one person and branding them down on others. Wherever you go, the people around you are your weapons - use them through 17 varied missions of assassination, interrogation, and mayhem as you exact your revenge on the world.

470110.overview:
The wastelands are a dangerous place, filled with wolves and monsters ready to turn anyone foolish enough to venture there into a handy meal. A young girl named Natsuki has ended up stranded there after her buggy broke down, and must now navigate the rough terrain and find a path to safety.

HuntersLunch is a puzzle game similar to classics like Adventures of Lolo and Sokoban, and is a sequel to SummerVacation. Each single-screen stage is a puzzle where you must reach the goal, and is filled with various tools to help you, terrain to traverse, and enemies to get in your way. You can only cross rocky terrain using a buggy, but can only cross spiked land on foot; rocks can be destroyed with hammers, bridges can let you cross water, and drums can be pushed around to block attacks or fill holes dug with a shovel.

The game includes 30 different puzzles to solve, and will save a replay of your most efficient solution for each puzzle. There are also five different BGM tracks to choose from, and two characters to play as, as well as Natsuki's original outfit from SummerVacation.

470111.overview:
How smart are you? Take this IQ test and find out!

Features include a detailed IQ breakdown, question generation that allows for retesting, and a full length 50 question test.

470112.overview:
Turn your TV into a Hypnotizing machine.

WARNING: USE AT YOUR OWN RISK!

470113.overview:
The fastest turtle in the world is back, and he's bringing 3 friends!

Engage in intense 4 player action as you try to work together to progress through levels, while trying to outdo each other's high scores!

An all new game with upgraded graphics, new levels and for the first time ever, Hurdle Turtle swims!

470114.overview:
Space is still a dangerous placed for even the most seasoned starship pilot, full of asteroids, multicolored floating blocks, and space mines. It's still even more dangerous when your accelerator is stuck to the floor and your brakes are out.

Can you survive long enough to get that elusive high score or are you still destined to add a new crater to the face of an unsuspecting asteroid?

470115.overview: Hypotenuse: The longest side of a right angle triangle... or the proper way to kill a rectangle ninja!

470116.overview:
To celebrate Hurdle Turtle's 3rd birthday and the upcoming release of Hurdle Turtle 2, we proudly present this 2nd companion to the original game which can also be enjoyed as a standalone title.

Take Hurdle Turtle through a gauntlet of holiday themed levels and keep challenging your own hiscores until the sequel arrives this fall!

470117.overview: Can your thumb act fast? Play many challenging games that make use of the four face buttons and test your timing, speed and nerve!

470118.overview: A collection of addictive multiplayer mini-games. Play it with your friends on split-screen or over Xbox Live. This includes an online matchmaking system to play with random opponents, and AI bots for an extra challenge or if you would like to play by yourself.

470119.overview:
Your space-brakes are out, the accelerator is stuck, and you can't stop. Hypership Out of Control is a scrolling shooter for up to four players. The titular Hypership continually accelerates forward, and the player must shoot and avoid obstacles while collecting coins and items trying to get the highest score possible before crashing.

The game includes several modes, including a standard mode where the speed limit increases after each wave, a "hardcore" mode with even higher difficulty, and even a practice mode. In the multiplayer mode, crashed players can be revived by those who are still alive.

470120.overview: A massive electrical failure has occurred in Power City. As a result, lines are surging, and the doors at the animal store opened automatically releasing dogs and hawks. Fixing the lines won't be easy, be sure to save money for better tools, faster boots, and Clones just in case. Do you have what it takes to restore electricity to Power City and become the #1 Hydro Electric Worker?

470121.overview: The fastest turtle in the world is back for more zany 8-bit arcade action in 3 all new levels! Join him and his new pal Pirate Turtle as they race to a banging chiptune soundtrack composed by Octapus! This companion to the original game can also be enjoyed as a standalone title.

470122.overview: Hurdle Turtle is a game about a turtle who doesn't believe that "slow and steady wins the race"; he believes in going as fast as he possibly can! The player controls a turtle who moves forward at an ever-accelerating rate, and must dodge obstacles and jump over hurdles to keep from crashing. Run out of lives, and the run is over. The game includes three different courses to play, and also includes a two-player simultaneous mode. The game tracks the best score on each course.

478367.overview: Ready to kill some Stick Figures? You'll get your chance in this hilarious and challenging 2D side-scrolling shooter. 14 Levels, 7 Bosses, 8 Vehicle Types including (Tank, Jet, Helicopter, Jeep, Hovercraft, LZR-80, Bomber, and Speed Boat). Play Campaign or Survival Modes, alone or with a friend on Xbox Live or System Link.

481466.overview: This game is perfect for all ages; left, right and jump is all that’s needed. The beautiful soundtrack, smooth gameplay and visuals of the environments bring this game to life, making the game very enjoyable and relaxing to play.
